business_summary: Kingclean Electric Co.,Ltd, an electric household company, manufactures and sells home appliances, kitchen appliances, and garden tools under the KingClean brand in the People's Republic of China. Its products include cleaning products, such as vacuum cleaners, air purifiers, water purifiers, and kitchen appliances, as well as garden tools, and core component business including high-speed digital motors, precision aluminum alloy parts, precision molds, and electronic components. The company also provides coffee machines, kitchen and environmental appliances, personal care, and high-pressure washers. The company also exports its products. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Suzhou, the People's Republic of China.
